svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: How skillcheck works
svg.desc: How skillcheck works. 19 components in 2 groups. Connections: Pull request to SkillCheck action; SkillCheck action to Discover skills; pre-commit hook to Discover skills; skillcheck lint to Discover skills; Playground to Pure lint core; Discover skills to Read SKILL.md; Read SKILL.md to Split frontmatter; Split frontmatter to Rules SC0xx to SC3xx; Rules SC0xx to SC3xx to Evals check; Evals check to Cross-skill and config; Rule registry to Rules SC0xx to SC3xx; Extension registry to Rules SC0xx to SC3xx; Cross-skill and config to Report; Cross-skill and config to Job summary; Cross-skill and config to Badge JSON; Cross-skill and config to SARIF 2.1.0; Report to PR annotations (--format github); SARIF 2.1.0 to Code scanning (upload-sarif).

text.tspan: One lint pipeline behind the CLI, the GitHub Action and the pre-commit hook. The playground runs its pure core in the browser.
OPTIONAL, A STEP IN YOUR OWN WORKFLOW
